title: Recommendation System Competition Platform (CS145-RecSys)
summary: A course competition platform, built on the Sim4Rec simulation framework, in which students design recommendation algorithms that maximize revenue through multi-iteration learning against synthetic users and items. Its vendored Sim4Rec module generator.py imports SDV's CopulaGAN, CTGAN, GaussianCopula and TVAE synthesizers (and sdv.evaluation.evaluate) to produce the synthetic user/item populations the simulation runs on.
